video.title: Mountain Weather Update 11/13, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Storm system #1 moving into CA.  This paves the way for a three storm cycle 11/13-11/22.  Storm #3 could turn into a deeper CO low pressure system.  Temps turn colder across the West after storm #2 with widespread snow into storm system #3.
